greeting: Hello, I am Stretch. I can either help you pick something or open a drawer. Choose the task on the user interface shown.
demo_grasp: You want me to find and pick {object}.
demo_door_not_impl: At this time, I cannot open doors. You can choose one of the smaller drawers.
remember_object_location: I remember seeing {object} on {location}. I will first check if it is there.
ask_help: I have never seen this {object}, so I need to ask my all-knowing supreme overlord for likely locations.
not_found: I did not find {object} in {location}. Going to next location {location_next}.
likely_locations: The most likely locations for {object} are {locations_1}, {locations_2}, and {locations_3}. I will check these locations in order.
